## Review

- **Correct:** CONNECTING EventSources are installed in the single planner owner before awaiting OPEN, and replacement closes both stored sources (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1909-1924`, `2057-2097`, `2264-2309`, `4297-4388`).
- **Correct:** Readiness requires exact session and generation markers plus both underlying sources reporting OPEN, both during adoption and immediately before planner submission (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3327-3345`, `3732-3743`, `4421-4432`).
- **Correct:** Ambient attention fetches only status snapshots from `GET /v1/requests`; it does not poll permission arguments (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:2871-2927`). The remaining `GET /v1/permissions` is the bounded planner-adoption reconciliation, not the three-second attention poll (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:4479-4520`).
- **Correct:** Cancellation POST acceptance leaves `streaming` and `active_turn_id` intact until terminal SSE and checks both HTTP and body-level `ok` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3147-3219`). This matches current ocean-os wire, which transitions to `Cancelling` and returns `ok:true` before eventual terminal state (`/Users/smathdaddy-macbook/ocean-os/crates/ocean-daemon/src/main.rs:1666-1719`).
- **Correct:** Composer Stop becomes disabled with “Stopping…” accessible name/title only for the exact active request whose cancel POST is pending (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/app.rs:2501-2526`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:886-893`).
- **Correct:** Permission actions require matching permission ID, focused session, active request, decision token, and focused pending-permission state; background request snapshots cannot authorize a decision (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:211-238`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island_dynamic.rs:304-381`). This agrees with ocean-os token enforcement (`/Users/smathdaddy-macbook/ocean-os/crates/ocean-daemon/src/main.rs:1722-1773`).
- **Correct:** Focused permission details originate from session-filtered control SSE; global request snapshots contribute only status and IDs (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:2213-2341`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:115-190`).
- **Note:** The known pre-existing `switch_session` snapshot/SSE cursor gap remains distinct from these fixes: snapshot loading is spawned and `connect()` starts immediately, so live frames can theoretically arrive before hydration overwrites state (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3223-3230`). The new reconnect generation guard does not close that ordinary switch cursor gap.
- **Note:** The requested `plan.md` and `progress.md` were absent at the supplied paths.
- **Note:** No test suite was executed during this constrained review. Inline regression tests covering exact stream ownership, cancellation response semantics, focused permission authority, and stopping state were inspected.
- **Blocker:** None found within the requested focus.

## Review

- **Correct:** CONNECTING EventSources are installed in the single planner owner before awaiting OPEN, and replacement closes both stored sources (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:1909-1924`, `2057-2097`, `2264-2309`, `4297-4388`).
- **Correct:** Readiness requires exact session and generation markers plus both underlying sources reporting OPEN, both during adoption and immediately before planner submission (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3327-3345`, `3732-3743`, `4421-4432`).
- **Correct:** Ambient attention fetches only status snapshots from `GET /v1/requests`; it does not poll permission arguments (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:2871-2927`). The remaining `GET /v1/permissions` is the bounded planner-adoption reconciliation, not the three-second attention poll (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:4479-4520`).
- **Correct:** Cancellation POST acceptance leaves `streaming` and `active_turn_id` intact until terminal SSE and checks both HTTP and body-level `ok` (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3147-3219`). This matches current ocean-os wire, which transitions to `Cancelling` and returns `ok:true` before eventual terminal state (`/Users/smathdaddy-macbook/ocean-os/crates/ocean-daemon/src/main.rs:1666-1719`).
- **Correct:** Composer Stop becomes disabled with “Stopping…” accessible name/title only for the exact active request whose cancel POST is pending (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/app.rs:2501-2526`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:886-893`).
- **Correct:** Permission actions require matching permission ID, focused session, active request, decision token, and focused pending-permission state; background request snapshots cannot authorize a decision (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:211-238`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island_dynamic.rs:304-381`). This agrees with ocean-os token enforcement (`/Users/smathdaddy-macbook/ocean-os/crates/ocean-daemon/src/main.rs:1722-1773`).
- **Correct:** Focused permission details originate from session-filtered control SSE; global request snapshots contribute only status and IDs (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:2213-2341`; `crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/island.rs:115-190`).
- **Note:** The known pre-existing `switch_session` snapshot/SSE cursor gap remains distinct from these fixes: snapshot loading is spawned and `connect()` starts immediately, so live frames can theoretically arrive before hydration overwrites state (`crates/ocean-surface-ui/src/daemon.rs:3223-3230`). The new reconnect generation guard does not close that ordinary switch cursor gap.
- **Note:** The requested `plan.md` and `progress.md` were absent at the supplied paths.
- **Note:** No test suite was executed during this constrained review. Inline regression tests covering exact stream ownership, cancellation response semantics, focused permission authority, and stopping state were inspected.
- **Blocker:** None found within the requested focus.
